name: io.github.CyberPunk11147/cyberwarex-domain-intel
title: Domain risk verdict + DNS, RDAP, TLS facts, pay per call (x402)
description: Is this domain safe? Risk verdict from DNS, RDAP age and TLS cert, 20 per call. No key: x402.

tools.name: domain_score
tools.description: One risk verdict for a domain or host: score 0-100, level low/medium/high and plain reasons (domain age, registry hold status, missing or expired certificate, no mail records, missing DMARC), built from live DNS, RDAP and a TLS handshake. Use before opening a link, trusting a sender or paying a vendor. $0.005 USDC per call via x402; a failed read is not charged.

domain.description: Domain or host name, e.g. example.com

x_payment.description: x402 payment: base64 PaymentPayload for the invoice returned by an unpaid call (same value as the X-PAYMENT / PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header).

tools.name: domain_score_batch
tools.description: The domain_score verdict for up to 20 domains in one call and one payment, results per domain (a domain that could not be read is listed with its error). $0.04 USDC per call via x402; not charged when no domain could be read.

x_payment.description: x402 payment: base64 PaymentPayload for the invoice returned by an unpaid call (same value as the X-PAYMENT / PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header).

tools.name: dns_records
tools.description: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS and CNAME records for a domain from public resolvers. $0.002 USDC per call via x402; a lookup failure is not charged.

name.description: Domain or host name, e.g. example.com

tools.description: Registrar, created and expiry dates, age in days and status codes for a registered domain, read from its registry over RDAP. $0.002 USDC per call via x402.
